queries.name: delta_reproduction_genetics_objects
queries.sql: SELECT TOP (1000) s.name AS schema_name, o.type_desc, o.name AS object_name FROM sys.objects o JOIN sys.schemas s ON s.schema_id=o.schema_id WHERE o.is_ms_shipped=0 AND o.type IN ('U','V','P') AND (LOWER(o.name) LIKE '%animal%' OR LOWER(o.name) LIKE '%equino%' OR LOWER(o.name) LIKE '%caball%' OR LOWER(o.name) LIKE '%yegua%' OR LOWER(o.name) LIKE '%potro%' OR LOWER(o.name) LIKE '%semental%' OR LOWER(o.name) LIKE '%reproduct%' OR LOWER(o.name) LIKE '%insemin%' OR LOWER(o.name) LIKE '%semen%' OR LOWER(o.name) LIKE '%pajuela%' OR LOWER(o.name) LIKE '%embrion%' OR LOWER(o.name) LIKE '%donante%' OR LOWER(o.name) LIKE '%receptora%' OR LOWER(o.name) LIKE '%gestacion%' OR LOWER(o.name) LIKE '%parto%' OR LOWER(o.name) LIKE '%camada%' OR LOWER(o.name) LIKE '%pedigree%' OR LOWER(o.name) LIKE '%genealog%' OR LOWER(o.name) LIKE '%raza%' OR LOWER(o.name) LIKE '%especie%') ORDER BY s.name, o.type_desc, o.name;

queries.name: delta_partnerships_contracts_objects
queries.sql: SELECT TOP (1000) s.name AS schema_name, o.type_desc, o.name AS object_name FROM sys.objects o JOIN sys.schemas s ON s.schema_id=o.schema_id WHERE o.is_ms_shipped=0 AND o.type IN ('U','V','P') AND (LOWER(o.name) LIKE '%contrato%' OR LOWER(o.name) LIKE '%convenio%' OR LOWER(o.name) LIKE '%aparceria%' OR LOWER(o.name) LIKE '%aparcer%' OR LOWER(o.name) LIKE '%medieria%' OR LOWER(o.name) LIKE '%arrendam%' OR LOWER(o.name) LIKE '%particip%' OR LOWER(o.name) LIKE '%asociacion%' OR LOWER(o.name) LIKE '%cooperativ%' OR LOWER(o.name) LIKE '%liquidacion%' OR LOWER(o.name) LIKE '%reparto%' OR LOWER(o.name) LIKE '%propietario%' OR LOWER(o.name) LIKE '%productor%') ORDER BY s.name, o.type_desc, o.name;

queries.name: delta_candidate_columns
queries.sql: SELECT TOP (2500) s.name AS schema_name, t.name AS table_name, c.column_id, c.name AS column_name, ty.name AS data_type, c.max_length, c.precision, c.scale, c.is_nullable, c.is_identity FROM sys.tables t JOIN sys.schemas s ON s.schema_id=t.schema_id JOIN sys.columns c ON c.object_id=t.object_id JOIN sys.types ty ON ty.user_type_id=c.user_type_id WHERE t.is_ms_shipped=0 AND (LOWER(t.name) LIKE '%animal%' OR LOWER(t.name) LIKE '%equino%' OR LOWER(t.name) LIKE '%caball%' OR LOWER(t.name) LIKE '%semental%' OR LOWER(t.name) LIKE '%reproduct%' OR LOWER(t.name) LIKE '%insemin%' OR LOWER(t.name) LIKE '%semen%' OR LOWER(t.name) LIKE '%embrion%' OR LOWER(t.name) LIKE '%gestacion%' OR LOWER(t.name) LIKE '%pedigree%' OR LOWER(t.name) LIKE '%genealog%' OR LOWER(t.name) LIKE '%raza%' OR LOWER(t.name) LIKE '%especie%' OR LOWER(t.name) LIKE '%contrato%' OR LOWER(t.name) LIKE '%convenio%' OR LOWER(t.name) LIKE '%aparcer%' OR LOWER(t.name) LIKE '%medier%' OR LOWER(t.name) LIKE '%arrendam%' OR LOWER(t.name) LIKE '%particip%' OR LOWER(t.name) LIKE '%asociacion%' OR LOWER(t.name) LIKE '%cooperativ%' OR LOWER(t.name) LIKE '%liquidacion%' OR LOWER(t.name) LIKE '%reparto%') ORDER BY s.name, t.name, c.column_id;

queries.name: delta_candidate_foreign_keys
queries.sql: SELECT TOP (1500) schp.name AS parent_schema, tp.name AS parent_table, cp.name AS parent_column, fk.name AS fk_name, schr.name AS referenced_schema, tr.name AS referenced_table, cr.name AS referenced_column FROM sys.foreign_key_columns fkc JOIN sys.foreign_keys fk ON fk.object_id=fkc.constraint_object_id JOIN sys.tables tp ON tp.object_id=fkc.parent_object_id JOIN sys.schemas schp ON schp.schema_id=tp.schema_id JOIN sys.columns cp ON cp.object_id=fkc.parent_object_id AND cp.column_id=fkc.parent_column_id JOIN sys.tables tr ON tr.object_id=fkc.referenced_object_id JOIN sys.schemas schr ON schr.schema_id=tr.schema_id JOIN sys.columns cr ON cr.object_id=fkc.referenced_object_id AND cr.column_id=fkc.referenced_column_id WHERE (LOWER(tp.name) LIKE '%animal%' OR LOWER(tp.name) LIKE '%equino%' OR LOWER(tp.name) LIKE '%caball%' OR LOWER(tp.name) LIKE '%semental%' OR LOWER(tp.name) LIKE '%reproduct%' OR LOWER(tp.name) LIKE '%insemin%' OR LOWER(tp.name) LIKE '%semen%' OR LOWER(tp.name) LIKE '%embrion%' OR LOWER(tp.name) LIKE '%gestacion%' OR LOWER(tp.name) LIKE '%pedigree%' OR LOWER(tp.name) LIKE '%genealog%' OR LOWER(tp.name) LIKE '%contrato%' OR LOWER(tp.name) LIKE '%convenio%' OR LOWER(tp.name) LIKE '%aparcer%' OR LOWER(tp.name) LIKE '%medier%' OR LOWER(tp.name) LIKE '%arrendam%' OR LOWER(tp.name) LIKE '%particip%' OR LOWER(tp.name) LIKE '%asociacion%' OR LOWER(tp.name) LIKE '%cooperativ%' OR LOWER(tp.name) LIKE '%liquidacion%' OR LOWER(tp.name) LIKE '%reparto%' OR LOWER(tr.name) LIKE '%animal%' OR LOWER(tr.name) LIKE '%equino%' OR LOWER(tr.name) LIKE '%caball%' OR LOWER(tr.name) LIKE '%semental%' OR LOWER(tr.name) LIKE '%reproduct%' OR LOWER(tr.name) LIKE '%insemin%' OR LOWER(tr.name) LIKE '%semen%' OR LOWER(tr.name) LIKE '%embrion%' OR LOWER(tr.name) LIKE '%contrato%' OR LOWER(tr.name) LIKE '%convenio%' OR LOWER(tr.name) LIKE '%aparcer%' OR LOWER(tr.name) LIKE '%medier%' OR LOWER(tr.name) LIKE '%arrendam%' OR LOWER(tr.name) LIKE '%particip%' OR LOWER(tr.name) LIKE '%liquidacion%') ORDER BY schp.name, tp.name, fk.name;

queries.name: delta_candidate_keys_indexes
queries.sql: SELECT TOP (2000) s.name AS schema_name, t.name AS table_name, i.name AS index_name, i.is_primary_key, i.is_unique, i.type_desc, c.name AS column_name, ic.key_ordinal, ic.is_included_column FROM sys.tables t JOIN sys.schemas s ON s.schema_id=t.schema_id JOIN sys.indexes i ON i.object_id=t.object_id JOIN sys.index_columns ic ON ic.object_id=i.object_id AND ic.index_id=i.index_id JOIN sys.columns c ON c.object_id=ic.object_id AND c.column_id=ic.column_id WHERE t.is_ms_shipped=0 AND (LOWER(t.name) LIKE '%animal%' OR LOWER(t.name) LIKE '%equino%' OR LOWER(t.name) LIKE '%caball%' OR LOWER(t.name) LIKE '%semental%' OR LOWER(t.name) LIKE '%reproduct%' OR LOWER(t.name) LIKE '%insemin%' OR LOWER(t.name) LIKE '%semen%' OR LOWER(t.name) LIKE '%embrion%' OR LOWER(t.name) LIKE '%pedigree%' OR LOWER(t.name) LIKE '%genealog%' OR LOWER(t.name) LIKE '%contrato%' OR LOWER(t.name) LIKE '%convenio%' OR LOWER(t.name) LIKE '%aparcer%' OR LOWER(t.name) LIKE '%medier%' OR LOWER(t.name) LIKE '%arrendam%' OR LOWER(t.name) LIKE '%particip%' OR LOWER(t.name) LIKE '%asociacion%' OR LOWER(t.name) LIKE '%cooperativ%' OR LOWER(t.name) LIKE '%liquidacion%' OR LOWER(t.name) LIKE '%reparto%') ORDER BY s.name, t.name, i.index_id, ic.key_ordinal;

queries.name: delta_enterprise_integration_candidates
queries.sql: SELECT TOP (1200) s.name AS schema_name, o.type_desc, o.name AS object_name FROM sys.objects o JOIN sys.schemas s ON s.schema_id=o.schema_id WHERE o.is_ms_shipped=0 AND o.type IN ('U','V','P') AND (LOWER(o.name) LIKE '%cliente%' OR LOWER(o.name) LIKE '%proveedor%' OR LOWER(o.name) LIKE '%producto%' OR LOWER(o.name) LIKE '%almacen%' OR LOWER(o.name) LIKE '%invent%' OR LOWER(o.name) LIKE '%lote%' OR LOWER(o.name) LIKE '%activo%' OR LOWER(o.name) LIKE '%document%' OR LOWER(o.name) LIKE '%cuenta%pagar%' OR LOWER(o.name) LIKE '%cuenta%cobrar%' OR LOWER(o.name) LIKE '%cxp%' OR LOWER(o.name) LIKE '%cxc%' OR LOWER(o.name) LIKE '%autorizacion%') ORDER BY s.name, o.type_desc, o.name;
